title: CAMERA LOOK AHEAD
why: His yes to a camera look-ahead toward the cursor, longer for sniper-class guns. The camera already leaned a little toward your cursor; with a gun in your hands it now leans more, 0.20 of the distance from the screen centre to the cursor instead of 0.13, so you see farther along the line you shoot. The Marksman Rifle, the Longshot and the Meridian Lance, the guns with a long scope, look farther still at 0.30. Bare hands keep the old lean and the lean you get holding the aim button is unchanged. It eases in and out through the same camera ease as before, the world edge still holds, and nothing in the game rules changes.
now: The camera looks farther ahead toward your cursor, farthest with the long scoped guns.

edits.replacement: var lean=p.ads?(opticMag()>1?.46:.30):lookLean(p);   // v26.xx (feel12): the look-ahead, longer for the long guns
